# **Inspiration**

## **Creative Origin**

*Luma Guardians* first started with the **Zodiacs**. The first idea was to imagine the Zodiac signs as magical guardians, each tied to its own element and abilities. From that starting point, the setting grew into a galaxy-wide guardian system with mentors, disciples, branches, tests, ranks, and the hidden thirteenth Zodiac, Ophiuchus.

Magical girl and magical boy stories like *Pretty Cure*, *Sailor Moon, Balala Xiao Mo Xian and League Of Legend’s Star Guardian* later influenced the transformations and team dynamics. These influences helped to shape how the story feels, but the Zodiac remain its original foundation.

## **Aesthetic Direction**

The blossom and moonlight imagery was chosen simply because I love how they look. They were not based on the guardian system, and they do not represent every guardian group in the galaxy.

Instead, blossoms and moon express the identity of Luma Blossom and the Blossom Moon team. Other guardian groups can have completely different appearances, symbols, and transformation styles. The Blossom Moon aesthetic may gain additional meaning as the story develops, but it began as a creative choice based on what I enjoy.

## **Story and Character Inspiration**

At the heart of the story lies the relationship between mentors and disciples. Becoming a guardian is not only about receiving power. It means being chosen, guided, tested, and eventually deciding what kind of guardian they want to become. This allows the story to explore trust, responsibility, power elements, and the influence one person can have on another.

Additionally, we have made use of the Ophiuchus Zodiac in this story. Yes\! It is an official zodiac here. However, only the guardians know about this zodiac.

Official Zodiac guardians (Command System) vs Ophiuchus

The official system provides structure and protection, but it can overlook people who do not fit its rules. Ophiuchus protects self-awakened people or others whom the official system may refuse to see. Kind of like a refugee camp? But neither side is intended to be completely right or completely wrong.

## **Tone**

*Luma Guardians* has a bright, magical, and hopeful surface with darker lore beneath it. Transformations, friendship, celestial powers, and brave heroes exist alongside secret rankings, sealed memories, corrupt authority, rogue guardians, and False Stars hiding within the system. The darker elements are not meant to remove hope. They test whether hope and compassion can survive when trust is broken.

## **What Makes Luma Guardians Its Own Story**

The story expands the Zodiac idea into a guardian civilization that stretches across the galaxy. Its distinct elements include the 13 Zodiacs, the hidden Ophiuchus zodiac, self-awakening, the Command System, the secret Star Index, guardian roles and tests, mentorship, power inheritance, and trusted guardians who may secretly become False Stars.

The main message is that power alone does not make someone a guardian. A true guardian is defined by how they use their power, whom they choose to protect, and whether they continue to care for others when doing so becomes difficult.

## **Main Themes**

  - Hope and courage
  - Growth and transformation
  - Trust and secrecy
  - Mentorship and responsibility
  - Freedom and authority
  - Identity and belonging
  - Elemental Power inheritance
  - Second chances
  - Choosing compassion over control
  - Light surviving the darkness

The name Luma has its origins in Latin, derived from the word lumen which means light

<!-- tab: World Lore -->

# **Core World Lore**

Long ago, the world was protected by the **13 Zodiacs**.

The Zodiacs were the original guardians, each connected to a Zodiac sign and element. Over time, they began taking in disciples to train into future guardians.

The Luma guardians do not exist only on Earth. Across the galaxy, there are many guardian groups. Each group may have different themes, powers, mentors, and branches, but they are all part of the wider guardian world.

The main story currently focuses on the **Blossom Moon Group**.

-----

# **The 13 Zodiacs**

The 13 Zodiacs are the main source of guardian power.

The 12 main Zodiacs are tasked with protecting the world. They are connected to the official guardian system and are responsible for training guardians who protect others.

The hidden 13th Zodiac is **Ophiuchus**.

Ophiuchus is hidden from the public. Ordinary people do not know Ophiuchus exists, and most disciples are not told about it.

However, Full-Fledged Guardians know about Ophiuchus.

Ophiuchus’s role is different from the 12 main Zodiacs. Instead of protecting the world directly, Ophiuchus protects those who fall outside the official guardian system, especially self-awakened people who cannot sacrifice themselves to protect others(?), or individuals who want the power for their own cause.

Ophiuchus trains self-awakened individuals as freelance/independent guardians.

Ophiuchus does not stand against the guardians. Ophiuchus stands beside the ones they refuse to see.

-----

# **Ophiuchus and Freelance/Independent Guardians**

Ophiuchus is a Full-Fledged Guardian and the hidden 13th Zodiac.

Ophiuchus protects and trains self-awakened people as independent guardians outside the 12 Zodiac official command structure.

Ophiuchus-trained guardians are recognized as Full-Fledged Guardians if they pass their test, but they are not part of the 12 Zodiac’s official command system.

Ophiuchus guardians can refuse Command missions because they are independent. However, this can damage Command’s trust in them and may affect their Star Index.

Ophiuchus-affiliated guardians usually remain Grey Star in the official Command System, but they can become Bright Star/Clear Star if they cooperate often.

Only the main Ophiuchus and one of Ophiuchus’s branches are allowed to take disciples.

They do not have a fixed disciple limit, but every disciple must be registered.

A Full-Fledged Guardian from the 12 Zodiac system can transfer to be a disciple of the Ophiuchus. This is legal, but heavily watched.

If a guardian transfers without reporting it, they may be treated as rogue. Command may also reject the transfer.

<!-- tab: Power System -->

# **Power Awakening**

Powers can be awakened in two main ways.

## **Guardian Awakening**

A Full-Fledged Guardian can choose a disciple and awaken their power by channelling part of their own power into them.

This creates a connection between mentor and disciple, allowing them to sense when the other is in danger and locate each other over short distances. However, When the disciple becomes a Full-Fledged Guardian, the connection weakens, but doesn’t disappears completely.

## **Self-Awakening**

A person’s power can awaken naturally without a guardian.

This can happen through:

  - Strong emotions
  - A desire to protect someone
  - Celestial events
  - A moment where the soul strongly reacts

Self-awakening is possible, but the power is unstable and incomplete without guidance.

A self-awakened person is not automatically illegal.

They are only considered illegal if they refuse guidance, abuse their power, or hide after being discovered.

Once a self-awakened person is found, they may choose official Zodiac training or Ophiuchus training, unless they are already dangerous.

Dangerous in a sense where they have killed, tortured others, or abused their power to force people to submit, etc.

-----

# **Giving Up Powers and Sealing**

Not all disciples become Full-Fledged Guardians.

Some fail.
Some give up.
Some may never be ready.

If a disciple gives up their power, their memories of being a disciple are erased.

Their training, magic traces, and memories of guardian life disappear. They return to normal life without knowing they once had powers.

However, their magic is not destroyed.

Their soul/core still remembers.

The power is only sealed again, which means it can awaken later under the right conditions.

A former disciple may not remember their past, but their body or soul may still react to magic, danger, old symbols, old allies, or familiar transformation phrases.

-----

# **Zodiac Elements and Branch Powers**

A disciple’s element is usually based on their Zodiac sign.

Examples:

  - Sagittarius → Fire
  - Capricorn → Earth
  - Aquarius → Water

However, a disciple can be taken in by a guardian of a different element during emergencies.

For example, Lumina is Sagittarius with Fire Elemental power, but was awakened under a Earth guardian due to an emergency.

This leaves small traces of Earth in his magic.

## **Branch Powers**

After becoming a Full-Fledged Guardian, new powers can emerge as a branch from the guardian’s original Zodiac element.

The structure is:

Zodiac Root(Original Element) → Branch of Individuality of the Guardian → Built on Branch of Individuality of the Guardian

Example:

Sagittarius(Fire) → Light → Moon / Sun

Because Sagittarius has Fire, its power can evolve into different forms.

  - Moon = Sailor Moon Reference lolll
  - Sun = bright light, heat
  - Light = light. Maybe got a better term
  - Umbra = dark/shadow

For Earth signs such as Capricorn or Taurus:

Earth can branch into:

  - Soil
  - Rock
  - Mineral
  - Plants -\> Flower, Trees

A guardian’s element power can be drained, but their Zodiac core cannot be removed. However, when a Guardian dies, the Core can be extracted before it fades.

Borrowed power operates at reduced strength unless they are continuously supplied with matching elemental power.

If borrowed power rejects the user, the transformation can become unstable. The user may be unable to access their evolved form, be hurt by the power, or lose control.

-----

# **Power Channeling**

## **Basic Power Channelling**

A Full-Fledged Guardian can channel part of their power into a disciple to awaken them.

## **Advanced Power Channelling**

A Full-Fledged Guardian can fully channel all of their active element power into someone else.

This drains the guardian’s active power.

However, their Zodiac core remains.

A drained element can slowly recover from the Zodiac core, but it takes time and may never return to the same original state.

If a guardian splits their power between disciples, each disciple can receive a portion of that power. However, the power can still grow differently depending on the disciple’s soul, core, and personality.

<!-- tab: Command System -->

# **The Command System**

The **Command System** is the official structure that manages guardian records, missions, tests, roles, and registrations.

The Command System is managed by supporting figures connected to the 13th zodiac, such as mascots, royal figures, record keepers, celestial spirits, and Command members.

The 13 Zodiacs watch the Command System from behind the scenes. They rarely interfere, but they may step in if Command becomes corrupted, abuses its authority, or if a major threat appears.

The Command System can contact Full-Fledged Guardians and send them on missions.

These missions may include:

  - Enemy sightings
  - Rogue guardian activity
  - Magical disturbances
  - Self-awakened incidents
  - Threats in specific areas, worlds, or space
  - Situations requiring rescue, support, investigation, or combat

The Command System is powerful, but it is not perfect. Its decisions can be questioned by Full-Fledged Guardians, especially if a mission risks innocent lives.

-----

# **The Command Center**

To access full guardian records, authorized members must use the **Command Center**.

The Command Center is the main base of the Command System. It holds the Star Index, guardian records, mission records, threat reports, test results, sealed information, and access logs.

Strategists and Command System members may be stationed there as part of their full-time duty. They monitor magical activity, track enemies, review mission reports, manage guardian records, and help assign missions.

Access to records is not based only on guardian role. It depends on **Command clearance**. Even though many strategists guardians have command clearance.

The Command Center machine logs all activity.

It records:

  - Who accessed the system
  - Whose record was accessed
  - Which section was viewed
  - When it was accessed
  - Whether the access was approved or suspicious

Every guardian can access their own record, but only partially.

They can see approved information such as their Guardian Name, role, branch, mentor, mission history, and passed tests.

They cannot see their Star Index, private Command notes, suspicion flags, hidden recommendations, or sealed information.

-----

# **The Star Index**

The **Star Index** is a hidden internal rating system used by the Command System.

Normal guardians do not know the Star Index exists.

The Star Index is used to judge a guardian’s trust level, risk, reliability, mission suitability, mentorship readiness, and overall standing.

Guardians do not see their Star Index when they access their own records.

Instead, they only see the practical information that Command allows them to know.

The people who know the Star Index exists are:

  - The 13 Zodiacs
  - High-ranking Command System members
  - High-ranking record keepers
  - Selected Command Strategists with special clearance

Most full-fledged Guardians do not know about the Star Index.

-----

# **Star Index Progression**

## **Young Star**

A disciple or newly awakened guardian who is still in training.

They are not Full-Fledged yet and cannot take any missions alone. They can only accompany their mentor on missions.

## **Rising Star**

A newly Full-Fledged Guardian who has passed their final test, but has not fully earned Command’s trust yet.

cannot take any missions alone. (Easy mission also cannot)

NOTE: Ophiuchus do not start here, only the 12 Zodiacs’ Disciples\!

## **Grey Star**

A watched guardian with uncertain trust.

They are not considered evil or rogue, but Command keeps a closer eye on them.

Ophiuchus-affiliated guardians usually start or remain here because they are outside the 12 Zodiac’s official command structure.

cannot take major missions alone. (Easy mission also cannot)

## **Steady Star**

A Full-Fledged Guardian who has completed several missions and proven they are reliable.

cannot take major missions alone.

## **Bright Star**

A trusted guardian in good standing with the Command System.

They are trusted, but are not allowed to take disciples yet.

Can take major missions alone.

## **Clear Star**

A fully trusted guardian who is allowed to take disciples.

To become a Clear Star, a guardian must prove they can guide others responsibly. They do not necessarily need to lead, but they must show that their actions, choices, and presence can positively influence others.

# **Special Star Index Statuses**

## **Fallen Star**

A guardian who has lost their rank, betrayed their duty, or turned rogue.

A Full-Fledged Guardian can lose their rank if they abuse their power, betray their duty, or fail the guardian code.

## **False Star**

A guardian hiding within the system as a Full-Fledged Guardian, but secretly working for the enemy.

A False Star is only marked as a False Star after their true loyalty is exposed.

Before discovery, they may appear under a normal Star Index status such as Rising Star, Steady Star, Bright Star, or even Clear Star.

False Stars are dangerous because they are Full-Fledged Guardians with bad intent. They are spies for enemies who managed to lurk inside the guardian system.

-----

# **Mentorship and Disciples**

Most people are born with sealed powers inside them, but not everyone awakens them.

A person can live their whole life without knowing they have power.

Some people do not have an elemental core. These people cannot awaken guardian powers, cannot be trained, and cannot become guardians.

## **Becoming a Disciple**

A person becomes a disciple when their sealed power is awakened, and they begin training under a Full-Fledged Guardian.

A Full-Fledged Guardian can awaken a disciple by channelling part of their own power into them.

This does not give the disciple the guardian’s exact power. Instead, it acts like a key that unlocks the disciple’s own sealed magic.

If the awakening power belongs to a different element, the disciple’s Zodiac Core may accept it. However, accepted power does not always remain. It may settle permanently and become an Inherited Element, or gradually fade after completing the awakening.

Because of this, awakening a disciple is a serious responsibility.

## **Why Guardians Cannot Awaken Everyone**

Full-Fledged Guardians do not awaken everyone because awakening magic is dangerous.

Not everyone who receives power becomes a protector. Some may turn rogue, reject the guardian system, or use their powers for personal gain(evil).

Because of this, guardians must choose disciples carefully. They must judge not only a person’s strength, but also their heart/behaviour.

## **Disciple Approval**

There is no fixed universal limit on how many disciples a Full-Fledged Guardian can take.

However, a guardian must still be approved by the Command System before taking disciples.

Command decides based on the guardian’s experience, stability, mission record, influence, teaching ability, and whether they can responsibly guide others.

If a guardian is not approved to take disciples, their record does not show a mentorship section.

If they are approved, the mentorship section appears.

If a guardian requests to take disciples and is denied, the mentorship section remains hidden. Instead, the guardian receives an official letter or notice from Command.

The letter gives a general reason, but Command decides how much information to reveal.

A guardian may reapply or appeal.

Repeated failed mentorship requests are recorded. Too many requests without improvement may trigger a review.

-----

# **Command Records**

The Command System keeps records of every registered guardian.

Possible record fields include:

  - Guardian Name
  - Real Name
  - Age
  - Gender
  - Birthday
  - Way of Contact
  - Mission history
  - Current assignments
  - Star Index
  - Guardian rank
  - Primary role
  - Passed tests
  - Relationship of any existing Guardians
  - Zodiac branch
  - Original element
  - Inherited or borrowed power
  - Power stability
  - Mentor / Master
  - Disciples under them
  - Power lineage
  - Warnings or Command notes

## **Real Names**

Command may keep a guardian’s real name, but it is highly confidential.

Most guardians only know each other by Guardian Name.

Real names are sealed identity records.

Only high-ranking Command members, assigned mentors, approved record keepers, and certain Command Strategists with clearance may view them.

-----

# **False Stars**

False Stars are Full-Fledged Guardians with bad intent.

They may be spies for enemies who successfully entered the guardian system.

They are not marked as False Star from the beginning.

Before they are discovered, they may appear as trusted guardians in the system.

They may have passed the test because:

  - They genuinely believed they were doing the right thing at the time
  - They were corrupted after passing
  - They used forbidden magic to hide their intent
  - They faked it until they made it
  - The test cannot perfectly detect future betrayal
  - They passed one role test but failed morally later
  - There is no strict limit on how many times someone can retake a test

False Stars may become part of the antagonist story.

One possible antagonist idea is that one of the Main Zodiacs has gone rogue and is abusing power behind the scenes.

<!-- tab: Guardian Tests -->

# **Guardian Tests**

To become a Full-Fledged Guardian, a disciple must pass a final test.

The official Command System designed multiple test types based on guardian roles.

# A guardian can pass multiple test types, but they must have/choose one primary role.

# \-----

# **Role Assignment**

A guardian can pass multiple role tests, but they must have/choose one primary role.

The Command System can recommend or assign a primary role.

The mentor may appeal the decision.

A disciple cannot be forced into any role by Command.

If they qualify for a role but refuse it, that role is sealed from their public record and they may receive their next strongest role.

NOTE for Author: a mentor can strongly push or assign a disciple into a role. If the disciple strongly objects, they can request a role review from Command.

-----

# **Main Test Types**

The 12 main Zodiacs are tasked with protecting the world, so their test focuses more on whether someone can protect others even when afraid.

Ophiuchus’s test focuses on whether someone will misuse power if given freedom.

The 12 Zodiacs ask:

“Will you protect others, even if it costs you?”

Ophiuchus asks:

“When power is in your hands, will you still choose not to harm?”

## **Attacker Test**

For guardians suited for direct combat and front-line battle. Inclusive of Range Combat and Close Combat

## **Support Test**

For Guardians suited for protecting, sustaining, assisting, or improving the effectiveness of others.

Support specialties may include healing, barriers, tanking, rescue, buffing, Core stabilisation, technical support, and magical research.

Some Support Guardians are active field members, while others primarily work behind the scenes as healers, researchers, engineers, or other specialists.

## **Shadow Test**

For guardians who act in secret.

Their work includes spying, tracking, infiltration, sabotage, rescue, and capturing rogue guardians.

Shadow guardians are not assassins by default.

## **Strategist Test**

For guardians suited for research, planning, analyzing enemy movements, monitoring threats, helping conduct tests, and assisting the Command System.

Strategists may work with the Command System, but being a Strategist does not automatically give higher access.

Only Command System’s Strategists with clearance can access deeper information.

## **Ophiuchus Test**

Ophiuchus disciples take a different test.

The Ophiuchus test focuses on restraint, self-control, and whether the disciple can hold power without abusing it.

# **How the Tests Work**

The Attacker, Support, Shadow, Strategist and Ophiuchus tests all happen at the same time.

This is how the Command System identifies the disciple’s primary role.

A disciple may think they are suited for Attacker, but the Command System may recognize them as Support, Shadow, or Strategist instead.

This means every disciple is also judged on whether they can hold power without abusing it.

For the official route, the main focus is identifying the guardian’s role. The Ophiuchus test is included as a safety check.

For the Ophiuchus route, the main focus is restraint and self-control. The four main roles are included as hidden observations.

Ophiuchus disciples are only told they are taking the Ophiuchus test.

After the test, if they qualify for any main role, both the mentor and disciple are informed.

If someone fails Ophiuchus’s test, they remain Ophiuchus’s disciple, are watched closely, and may retake the test.

If someone passes a main role test but fails the Ophiuchus test, they cannot become Full-Fledged yet. They remain a disciple and must retake the test.

Failing a test does not erase someone’s power. They remain a disciple and may retake the test later.

There is no strict lifetime limit on test retakes, but repeated attempts are recorded and watched. Too many failed attempts may cause Command to investigate the disciple’s intent.

# **Ageing**

A Guardian ages normally until their Zodiac Core fully stabilises. After that, their physical ageing slows dramatically. Their apparent age is influenced by when their core matured, their health and the condition of their magic.

# **Transformation Item**

A transformation item forms when a Guardian first awakens. Its appearance reflects the Guardian’s personality, branch and developing power. The item is bound to its owner’s Zodiac Core and cannot be activated by another person.

When inactive, it resembles an ordinary accessory. When the Guardian says their transformation phrase, the item draws power from their Zodiac Core and releases their Guardian form. If damaged or lost, it can eventually reform, but the Guardian cannot transform until their connection to it recovers.

There is an Awakening Fever that will happen at the within 2 weeks to 4 weeks after core is awakened?
